premium.basis: 40% premium to the July 8, 2016 closing price ($15.50), as stated in the SC 14D9

value_inflection_events.event: Q4 2014 earnings and CEO retirement announcement
Q2 2015 earnings and new CEO appointment
January 2016 Reuters article about potential sale

leaked_early.details: Reuters reported Sagent was considering a sale on January 13, 2016, nearly 6 months before the official announcement on July 11, 2016.

notes: A highly competitive multi-party auction with initial inbound interest, later converted to a broad outbound process in April 2016; Nichi-Iko won over Party A despite Party A's higher initial bids of up to $27.45/sh, due to Nichi-Iko's superior closing certainty and ability to match the final $21.75 price without regulatory or financing risks.
